name: Oaxaca

standard.note: Oaxaca's colorful plate lines up figures in traditional dress from the state's eight regions along the bottom, set among maguey plants that nod to the mezcal country.

notes: Image is the official canje portal's artwork (1024x352, ratio 2.9): it shows the private-car plate in full with the public-transport plate cropped at the right edge. Picked from Bing's index; oaxaca.gob.mx and the canje portal block this environment (WAF 'pagina web bloqueada' / proxy 403), so the URL was not loaded directly here. The design was introduced June 2023 (Semovi, Salomon Jara administration); the mandatory Canje de Placas 2025 ended Sept 30, 2025, so earlier designs should be off the road (not confirmed from an official text). No specialty plates found.
